post.summary: Record new trades on an existing partner portfolio
post.description: Appends one or more new trades to the partner portfolio and replaces currentHoldings with the supplied post-trade snapshot. Server retains at most the most recent 5000 trades (oldest dropped by executedAt). To update historicHoldings (e.g. after a position closes), use PATCH /v1/sdk/partner-portfolios/{id}.

post.summary: Archive a partner account and stop its insight eligibility

get.summary: List portfolios provisioned by this organization through the snapshot feed

put.summary: Create or replace a native portfolio snapshot
put.description: Creates the portfolio and its internal client record on the first request. No separate client call or client ID is required. Atomically replaces the complete holdings and cash for this organization and external ID. Revisions must increase; identical retries are idempotent. Omitted holdings are removed. Triggers native valuation, price-history backfill and portfolio calculations. Does not execute trades.

get.summary: Read a native portfolio and its calculation status
Read the insight for an exact asset subject

post.description: Mints a ready-to-use iframe URL for the Clarity card + chat surface. The URL embeds a short-lived signed token that scopes the iframe to one portfolio (by id or inline payload) and the listed parent origins. Drop the returned `url` into an iframe; the `token` is exposed for advanced use (e.g. SSR or non-iframe contexts).

post.summary: Get the shared market update card
post.description: Returns the organization's shared "what is happening in the world" Clarity card — the same market briefing shown across every portfolio, with inline citations and their source claims. The status field reports whether the latest successful content is fresh or stale. The deprecated isRefreshing field remains false for cached content. Portfolio-agnostic; no user context required. Returns null when no card has been generated yet.

isRefreshing.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Cached market updates always return false; use status for content freshness.

post.summary: Get the generic stock/crypto Clarity read
post.description: Returns the holder-agnostic Clarity read for one asset — the same 'what is happening with this stock' content shared by everyone holding it. Identify the asset by ticker `symbol` and `name`. Returns null when no read has been generated yet.

Returns the user's composed portfolio card for the requested window (1D, 1W, 1M, YTD or 1Y; default 1D) — the book's figures and events with the published market update and the latest authored portfolio read spliced in — together with that read (its headline, text, dated tests and sources). Both are null until the nightly composer and the weekly read have run. Requires the x-user-id header; no model is invoked per request.

Returns the user's personalized analysis for one holding — how the day's developments connect to that specific position — with its cited sources. Identify the holding by `assetId`. Requires the x-user-id header. Returns empty fields when no analysis has been generated yet.

Returns the full source articles behind Clarity citations, including the article body text. Pass the `sourceDocumentId` values carried on a card or chat answer's claims. Only documents within your organization scope (or global) are returned.
